entries.value: The work I would most want to do at DRW is on systems where latency, correctness, and failure modes are all real constraints rather than abstractions. At Summer Atlantic Capital / SAC Nexus I build the machine-learning core of an anomaly-detection and alert-prioritization system: event ingestion, temporal sequence modeling over event streams with RNN and Transformer-style approaches, anomaly scoring, and a learning-to-rank layer for prioritizing alerts, served through a versioned FastAPI microservice I own along with the repo and CI scaffold. What I care about there is operational usefulness, since a detector that fires too often just creates a second problem. That maps closely to risk and monitoring applications. I am also drawn to infrastructure work where determinism matters. In my Playwright-based application agent I put every mutating capability behind fail-closed flags and moved state through an explicit state machine backed by SQLite, because state divergence across processes is where automation gets dangerous. I would be happy on a trading systems, risk, or data infrastructure team. I am an undergraduate, so I care most about owning a real piece of a system and having senior people tell me where my design is wrong.
